profile.name: Alina Wu
profile.summary: Computer science student focused on human-centered design and software development. Interested in how people understand and use technology.

welcome.title: Alina
welcome.description: Computer Science at the University of Washington. Code, physical systems, and questions about the people around them.

readme.title: WORKSPACE NOTES
paragraphs: Read before reorganizing the lab. PROJECTS holds finished work. Working notes, references, and unfinished ideas stay where they were last used.
Check the latest LAB LOG before picking up an old thread. Design decisions belong in the notebook, references on the shelf, physical iterations in the drawer, and open questions on the board.
Keep the unfinished parts in place. Small observations, failed attempts, and half-built ideas may still be useful later.

entries.title: Joined Thermo Fisher Scientific
body: I'm happy to share that I am joining Thermo Fisher Scientific as a Software Engineering Intern in Shanghai.
I'm excited to learn, contribute, and work across computer vision, robotics, and scientific software.

map.name: shanghai-map.case
map.title: Quality of Life in Shanghai
map.copy: An interactive neighborhood map informed by questionnaires and interviews, helping residents locate useful facilities within walking distance.

allocation.name: course-allocation.py
allocation.title: Automatic and Satisfactory Course Assignment
allocation.copy: An allocation system designed around satisfaction and efficiency using Simultaneous Eating and Birkhoff Decomposition.

emg.name: emg-monitor.device
emg.title: Muscle Usage & Behavior Monitor
emg.copy: A multi-device system that collects EMG signals over Bluetooth, classifies them on ESP32 microcontrollers, and sends exercise data to a mobile interface.

research.title: How do principles shape perceived relevance?
research.copy: Analyzing how agreement on principles affects perceived relevance between cases through surveys, normalized data, and Pandas-based CSV pipelines.
research.quote: STATUS: the relationship is still under investigation.

internship.title: Vision, motion, and laboratory workflows.
internship.copy: Work across YOLO26 computer vision, ROS2 robot-arm motion, 3500Dx scientific-software testing, QANTIS workflow analysis, and technical onboarding.
